snippet.title: Turok: Origins - Official Story Trailer | gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Turok: Origins is headed to PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch 2, and PC in Spring 2027, and will let players battle dinosaurs, aliens, and more alone of with friends.

To do so, players will get to take utilize an arsenal of futuristic weapons, harness Turok powers, and explore the Lost Lands.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
